title: Concentration-shifted load sharing
claim: A concentration-dependent load-sharing extension improves transfer to reserved material formulations beyond simple calibrated log-speed interpolation.
scope: Material formulation, repeated representations linked. Two-point calibration at 0.2 and500 mm/s; score0.28–10 mm/s.
limitations: Public source-aware confirmation is now exposed.
Predictive success does not prove a causal mechanism, exhaustive novelty, or realized industrial impact.
Alternative valid equations are admissible under the same task.
negative_evidence: The proposal is unsupported: confirmation MAE 0.0177607 exceeds log-speed interpolation 0.013141. Development gains do not survive this transfer test.

title: Mechanistic or transfer falsification
claim: Concentration alone does not guarantee calibrated curve-shape transfer across surface treatment and supplier.
rationale: The reserved-formulation reference MAE exceeds log-speed interpolation despite a large development improvement.
scope: The tested equations and current data only; no claim of universal impossibility.
